name: mj359d-cos-window
goal: Fit the recorded oversized watchdog batch into the 80x24 CoS composer and deliver the next alert.

evidence: 8b9716 confirmed the recorded 3100-character prompt scrolls the 80x24 composer, hiding its prompt marker and preventing Enter.
Existing tmux fixtures do not reproduce composer overflow. Replay the recorded queue through the authentic watchdog port and a fixture that hides the prompt for oversized drafts.
The committed 80x24 fixture accepts the paste into the scrolled draft, then records zero Enter presses. The unchanged regression requires one.
Bound the complete message, including receipt references, to 720 bytes. Render oversized rows as item references and a short sentence, and include only slot detail that fits.
The same frozen test command failed at d4548a51ce without Enter, then passed at a53d022680. The bounded prompt included all eight pointers and a ninth alert was delivered in the next round.
